pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which verse says that nothing is impossible with God? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 7:14
   D. Luke 1:37

2. What did Mary answer to the angel's message? (1 mark)
   A. I do not believe you
   B. Leave me
   C. I must ask the king
   D. I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled

3. How did Zechariah get his speech back? (1 mark)
   A. After writing "His name is John"
   B. After a long sleep
   C. After a healing by Jesus
   D. After visiting Jerusalem

4. What did John call people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Fight
   B. Repent
   C. Trade
   D. Rest

5. What is a miracle? (1 mark)
   A. An ordinary meal
   B. A school lesson
   C. A festival
   D. An amazing act that shows God's power

6. What did Bartimaeus do after he could see? (1 mark)
   A. He sold his cloak
   B. He went home to sleep
   C. He ran to the temple
   D. He followed Jesus

7. Which person is showing gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. A child who complains
   B. A child who forgets to thank
   C. A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   D. A child who laughs

8. What did Jesus ask about the other nine? (1 mark)
   A. Why were they sick?
   B. Who are they?
   C. Where are the other nine?
   D. Who healed them?

9. What does the miracle show about Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. He is a weak man
   B. He is only a teacher
   C. He is a king of Rome
   D. He has power over death

10. Which verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life"? (1 mark)
   A. John 11:25
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Luke 7:14
   D. Genesis 1:1

11. What does sharing at school help to build? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Laziness
   C. Kindness and unity
   D. Selfishness

12. Which is the best way to give? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing
   B. Grumbling
   C. Cheerfully and respectfully
   D. Boasting

13. What did she do when she found it? (1 mark)
   A. Sold it
   B. Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   C. Ignored it
   D. Hid it

14. Which of these is a righteous way of living? (1 mark)
   A. Lying
   B. Cheating
   C. Telling the truth
   D. Stealing

15. How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. About three thousand
   B. About three hundred
   C. About three
   D. About thirty

16. Which verse says that God so loved the world? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. John 3:16
   D. Acts 2:38

17. Who baptised Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Paul
   B. John the Baptist
   C. Stephen
   D. Peter

18. Who is a stranger? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Your cousin
   C. Someone you do not know
   D. Your grandmother

19. Why does a truthful person feel peaceful? (1 mark)
   A. They are popular
   B. They are rich
   C. They have nothing to hide
   D. They are old

20. What is one result of lying? (1 mark)
   A. More friends
   B. Better marks
   C. Peace of mind
   D. Loss of trust

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how the woman searched for the coin and what she did when she found it. (4 marks)

22. What is a mustard seed like, and what does it grow into? (2 marks)

23. Name two people you can trust at home or school. (2 marks)

24. Give three rules for staying safe from strangers. (3 marks)

25. Describe how the ten lepers showed faith. (3 marks)

26. Explain why trusting God is important and how a child shows that they trust Him. (5 marks)

27. State three challenges that children may face and how they can involve God. (3 marks)

28. Explain what the story teaches about the power of Jesus and His care for people. (4 marks)

29. Give two ways of helping a needy classmate. (2 marks)

30. Give two reasons why we should not take revenge. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Luke 1:37
   Luke 1:37 is the memory verse of this topic.

2. D — I am the Lord's servant, may your word to me be fulfilled
   Luke 1:38 records her humble answer.

3. A — After writing "His name is John"
   His mouth was opened when he wrote the name.

4. B — Repent
   John called people to turn from their sins.

5. D — An amazing act that shows God's power
   Miracles show God's power.

6. D — He followed Jesus
   Mark 10:52 says he followed Jesus along the road.

7. C — A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   Saying thank you shows gratitude.

8. C — Where are the other nine?
   Luke 17:17 records the question.

9. D — He has power over death
   Jesus is Lord of life.

10. A — John 11:25
   John 11:25 records Jesus' words.

11. C — Kindness and unity
   Sharing builds love and friendship.

12. C — Cheerfully and respectfully
   Kind giving respects the person.

13. B — Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   She invited others to celebrate.

14. C — Telling the truth
   Righteous living pleases God.

15. A — About three thousand
   Acts 2:41 says about three thousand.

16. C — John 3:16
   John 3:16 is the memory verse.

17. B — John the Baptist
   Matthew 3:13-17 says John baptised Jesus.

18. C — Someone you do not know
   A stranger is someone you do not know.

19. C — They have nothing to hide
   Truth brings a clear conscience.

20. D — Loss of trust
   People stop trusting a liar.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: She lit a lamp, swept the house, searched carefully until she found it, then called her friends and neighbours to rejoice with her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: A very small seed that grows into a large tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not go with them, do not accept gifts or lifts, do not give personal details, shout for help, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: They called out to Jesus; they obeyed His command to go to the priests before they were healed; one returned to give thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: God made us, loves us and is faithful. He hears prayers and has helped people in the Bible. A child shows trust by praying every day, reading the Bible, obeying His teaching, and thanking Him for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for faithfulness, 1 for prayer, 1 for Bible or obedience, 1 for thanks.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Illness, loss of a loved one, lack of school fees, bullying, exams. They can pray, trust God and ask trusted adults for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid challenge with a way of involving God, up to 3.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over death. He cares for the poor and lonely, such as widows. He acts out of compassion. People recognised God at work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Share a pencil or lunch, help with a lesson, welcome them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: It starts a cycle of hurt; it gets us in trouble; it breaks friendships; it displeases God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
